replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
It's essentially iron armor, iron sword, a bow with a few arrows, and food.

You pit two players together in an arena and they duel. It's a popular ladder on Badlion, I believe.

Anyways, I'd like to see this implemented though somehow I don't feel as if it would fit with the Avicus minigame vibe.
